Are you comfortable with that? Speaker A: Ma'am ये तो कम है, बाकी को सेम स्टेज पे ₹80,000 मिल रहा है मुझे आधा क्यों? [Ma'am, this is less. Interview over, came home, couldn't sleep. At 3 AM, an ad for English Seekho App appeared. Listened, understood, saw reviews, then took a 1 rupee trial. Used it continuously for three days, liked it. Didn't waste time, learned something, so continued for another month, today it's been six months. Every night for 15 minutes, instead of useless reels, practiced with the AI coach. If I spoke wrong, she corrected me, never judged, never made fun. One year later, interview at another company, without referral. This time I didn't stop in the HR round.] Speaker A: I am genuinely excited about this role and the team. Based on my research and the responsibilities involved, I was expecting something closer to ₹80,000. I bring four years of direct experience and I've led projects that delivered measurable results. Is there flexibility to revisit the number? Speaker C: Okay, I'll send you the offer letter by today EOD.
